items.label: ✨14-Piece Cushion Covers for Full Sofa Makeover
items.value: This patio cushion covers for outdoor furniture is designed to renew a 6-seat outdoor sectional sofa in one go. It includes 6 seat cushion covers (25.6"x25.6"x4"), 6 back cushion covers, and 2 side cushion covers. This cushion covers are perfect for refreshing your patio furniture set, sectional, or daybed. Providing a cost-effective solution to revitalize your entire patio conversation set.

items.label: 🌧️ Weather & UV Protection
items.value: Made from robust high-density Oxford fabric with a water-repellent finish, our outdoor furniture cushion covers effectively beads up light rain and spills for easy cleanup. The added UV-resistant coating protects against sun damage and fading, ensuring long-lasting color and durability for extended outdoor use.

items.label: 🏡Snug Fit with Anti-Slip & Ties Design
items.value: Features full-wrap zippers for easy insertion and a tailored look. The couch seat covers have non-slip silicone dots on the bottom, while back and side covers come with adjustable straps to securely fasten to the cushion, preventing slippage and keeping everything in place, even on windy days.

items.label: ✨Thoughtful Craftsmanship for Easy Maintenance
items.value: Built to last with reinforced double stitching around stress points and structured edge piping that maintains shape. The patio furniture cushion covers are machine washable for effortless care, allowing you to quickly refresh them and maintain a clean, inviting outdoor space.

items.label: 🎯 Perfect Match for Outdoor Living
items.value: Engineered to fit standard cushion sizes around 25.6"x25.6"x4" (with a slight tolerance for a snug fit). Please measure your cushion inserts before purchasing for the best match. Our customer service team is ready to assist you within 24 hours if you have any questions.
